import json
def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    ones=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==1]
    twos=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==2]
    (i1,j1),(i2,j2)=ones[0],twos[0]
    di=1 if i2>i1 else -1

    ri, rj = i2-di, j2-dj   # one-short targets

    while i!=ri and j!=rj:

    if i==ri:
        while j!=rj: j+=dj; cells.append((i,j))
    else:
        while i!=ri: i+=di; cells.append((i,j))
    for a,b in cells: g[a][b]=3
